description: The closed registry of redaction classes of authorization_decision.v1 obligations.redaction, and the rules that say which role gets which class on which action. classes equals the decision schema enum and the class list compiled into the dev-health-go policy-enforcement client: a class is added in this order, schema enum, this file, client release; an old client denies on a class it does not know. A class no rule uses is reserved. rules ship empty: no policy is set until a ruling names (role, action) rows. Which response field is which class is the consumer's table, not this file.

classes.description: Fields that reach a person: an email address, a phone number, a chat handle.
Fields that hold text a person typed: titles and bodies of pull requests and issues, commit messages, comments.
Fields that name or identify a person: a display name, a login, an author id, an external user id.
